description: This file contains the PHP class definition for Opencart\Catalog\Model\Design\Theme, including the getTheme method which retrieves theme information from a database based on store ID and route.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: A model class for interacting with theme data in the OpenCart catalog module, providing functionality to retrieve theme configurations based on route and store ID.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves theme information from the database for a given route, constrained by the current store ID.
